Deleting an app can lose app-stored data, so this requires care. If the problem remains, the app developer may need to help.

A trusted signed-in device and trusted phone number can help reset an Apple Account password. Choose Forgot Password and follow the official instructions. If available recovery factors are insufficient, account recovery may be necessary and may take time. Public support replies must not ask the customer to post passwords, verification codes or recovery information.
